title: The Wrong Hour
tagline: The papers say the vault was opened at 11:38 pm. The police built every alibi around that time. They were an hour out.

setting.place: Halvorsen & Wilde auction house, Ryder Street, London

briefing: The Winter Swan is a jewelled egg made for a Russian empress, due to be auctioned on Monday. On Saturday morning its velvet stand in the basement vault of Halvorsen & Wilde was empty.
The vault's computer log shows the door code was entered at 23:38 and the door shut again at 23:46. The newspapers printed it at once: VAULT RAIDED AT 11:38 PM.

The door code is shared by five senior staff. The police checked everybody's alibi for 11:38 pm and arrested the two people who had none. Mr. Foxy has asked to see the vault log itself, including the line at the top that nobody read.
rules: The Winter Swan was taken while the vault door was open, as recorded in the vault log.
Only the five suspects know the door code. The vault door can only be opened in person, from the corridor outside it.

suspects.name: Celeste Moreau
suspects.description: Catalogued the Winter Swan herself. Spent the evening at a charity gala in a silver sequinned gown.
suspects.motive: A private buyer offered her a fortune if the Swan 'never reached the auction'.
suspects.statement: I was at the Savoy gala from seven until a quarter past midnight. Two hundred people saw me. Then I took a taxi home to Hampstead.

suspects.name: Darnell Achebe
suspects.description: Designed the vault system. Arrested on Saturday because he had no alibi for 11:38 pm.
suspects.motive: Knows the vault better than anyone.
suspects.statement: I was home alone until about midnight. Then my son had a bad asthma attack and I drove him to St. Thomas' Hospital. We were in A&E for hours.

suspects.name: Magnus Ferreby
suspects.description: Runs the late-night online sales for buyers in Asia.
suspects.motive: Would earn a huge commission if the Swan sold privately through him.
suspects.statement: I ran the midnight online sale for our Hong Kong clients from my home studio in Richmond. I was on camera the whole time.

suspects.name: Hana Sato
suspects.role: Specialist, visiting from the Tokyo office
suspects.description: In London for the sale, staying at a hotel in Docklands, 40 minutes from Ryder Street.
suspects.motive: Argued that the Swan should be sold in Tokyo instead.
suspects.statement: I was in my hotel room on a video call with the Tokyo office. Their meeting was at half past eight in the morning, Tokyo time.

suspects.name: Owen Pryce
suspects.description: Works the front desk overnight. Arrested with Darnell because he had no alibi for 11:38 pm.
suspects.statement: At twenty to twelve I was walking my round of the upper floors. Nobody sees you on the round. After that I was at the front desk all night.

evidence.title: Vault door log
evidence.source: Vault control computer, printed in full
body: Header line: VAULT CONTROL v4.2 · ALL TIMES ARE COORDINATED UNIVERSAL TIME (UTC) · Friday 18 July

rows: Master code entered at corridor keypad

evidence.title: Time zone card
evidence.source: Pinned by the switchboard, for staff calling overseas offices
body: London in winter (late October to late March): UTC + 0 (GMT).
London in summer (late March to late October): UTC + 1 (British Summer Time, BST).

evidence.title: Savoy doorman and taxi receipt
evidence.source: Savoy hotel and Black Cab account, London times
body: Doorman: “Ms. Moreau left at 00:15. Silver dress, couldn't miss her. I put her in a cab myself.”
Taxi receipt on Celeste's company account: picked up 00:18, Savoy. Dropped off 00:31, Ryder Street.
Ryder Street is where Halvorsen & Wilde is. Hampstead is 6 kilometres the other way.

evidence.title: St. Thomas' Hospital A&E record
body: Patient: Sam Achebe, age 9, asthma. Brought in by father, Darnell Achebe.
Registered at desk: 00:22. Seen by doctor: 00:50. Discharged: 03:10. Father present throughout (nurse's note).

evidence.title: Hong Kong online sale
evidence.source: Halvorsen & Wilde live-stream archive, London times
body: Live sale, hosted by Magnus Ferreby from his Richmond studio: 00:00 to 01:30. He is on camera calling bids for the whole broadcast, with a ten-minute break from 00:55 to 01:05.

evidence.title: Tokyo office video call
body: Saturday 19 July, 08:30 to 09:15 (Tokyo time): weekly meeting. Hana Sato joined by video from London, camera on, showing her hotel room. Nobody left the call early.

evidence.title: Front desk camera
evidence.source: Lobby camera, London times on the picture
body: Owen Pryce is at the front desk continuously from 00:20 to 01:10, reading a newspaper and answering one phone call at 00:44. The corridor to the vault is in the basement, reached only by the back stairs.

evidence.title: Vault floor
body: Under the Swan's empty stand: one small silver sequin.

questions.prompt: What time zone are the vault log's times written in?
questions.explanation: The header line, which nobody read, says ALL TIMES ARE COORDINATED UNIVERSAL TIME (UTC).

questions.prompt: What did London clocks say when the vault door opened? (24-hour clock.)
questions.explanation: 18th July is summer, so London is on BST, UTC + 1. 23:38 UTC is 00:38 London time, just after midnight on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Hana's call ran from 08:30 to 09:15 Tokyo time. When was that in London?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is UTC + 9 and summer London is UTC + 1, so Tokyo is 8 hours ahead of London. 08:30 Tokyo is 00:30 London, so Hana was on camera in her hotel when the vault opened at 00:38.

questions.prompt: The police arrested two suspects. At the real time of the theft, where were they?

options.text: Darnell was in A&E with his son, and Owen was on camera at the front desk, nowhere near the basement

questions.explanation: Darnell registered at A&E at 00:22 and stayed all night. Owen was on the lobby camera from 00:20 to 01:10. Their missing alibis were for 23:38 London time, which is the wrong hour.

questions.prompt: Whose alibi stops working at the real time of the theft?
questions.explanation: Celeste's gala alibi covers 11:38 pm London, but she left the Savoy at 00:15. Her taxi dropped her at Ryder Street, the auction house, at 00:31, seven minutes before the vault opened.

Converted to London time, the vault opened at 00:38. Darnell, Magnus, Hana and Owen are all accounted for. Celeste was dropped at the auction house at 00:31, and a silver sequin from her gown was under the Swan's stand.

hints.question: q1
hints.text: Read the vault log from the very first line.

hints.question: q1
hints.text: Computers often keep one clock for the whole world. Does this one say which?

hints.question: q1
hints.text: The header spells it out in capitals.

hints.question: q2
hints.text: Is 18th July summer or winter in London?

hints.question: q2
hints.text: The time zone card tells you how far London is from UTC in summer.

hints.question: q2
hints.text: Add one hour to 23:38. Mind the midnight.

hints.question: q3
hints.text: Convert both cities to UTC first, then compare.

hints.question: q3
hints.text: Tokyo is UTC + 9, London in July is UTC + 1. What's the gap?

hints.question: q4
hints.text: Check the two arrested people against 00:38, not 23:38.

hints.question: q4
hints.text: Look at the hospital record and the lobby camera times.

hints.question: q4
hints.text: One was in A&E from 00:22, the other at the front desk from 00:20. Both are cleared.

hints.question: q5
hints.text: Look at the gala: when did she leave, and where did the taxi go?

hints.question: q5
hints.text: Dropped off at 00:31 on Ryder Street. That isn't Hampstead.

hints.question: q6
hints.text: Line up all five suspects at 00:38 London time.

hints.question: q6
hints.text: Four of them have records. One was dropped seven minutes from the vault, by the front door.

hints.question: q6
hints.text: What was found under the stand, and who was wearing it?

solution.summary: Celeste Moreau knew the vault log runs on UTC and that the papers would print 23:38 as if it were London time. She spent the evening in plain sight at the Savoy, left at 00:15 and took a taxi to Ryder Street. At 00:38 London time she keyed in the master code, lifted the Winter Swan, and was out eight minutes later. Everyone checked alibis for 11:38 pm, the one hour when she had two hundred witnesses. A sequin from her gown fell under the stand.

chain.step: The vault log is in UTC. In July London is UTC + 1, so the vault opened at 00:38 London time, not 23:38.
At 00:38 London: Darnell was in A&E, Magnus was live on camera, Hana was on the Tokyo call (00:30 to 01:15 London), and Owen was at the front desk.
Celeste left the gala at 00:15 and was dropped at Ryder Street at 00:31.
A silver sequin from her gown was under the empty stand.

eliminations.why: Registered at A&E with his son at 00:22, there until 03:10.
Live on camera from 00:00 to 01:30 London time. His only break was 00:55 to 01:05, after the vault had closed, and Richmond is far too far away.
On the Tokyo video call from 00:30 to 01:15 London time, camera on, in a hotel 40 minutes away.
On the lobby camera at the front desk from 00:20 to 01:10.

playtest.solvePath: Strong solvers spot the UTC header in the first few minutes; most need the level-1 hint. Once the real time is 00:38, every alibi has to be rechecked, and Celeste's taxi is the moment the case turns. Converting Tokyo time is the hardest arithmetic step.
pitfalls: Players converted Tokyo to London using 9 hours, forgetting summer time. The q3 hint now says to go through UTC.
Some players thought the sequin alone solves it. Without the time correction, Celeste has a 200-person alibi, so the sequin looks planted.
revisions: Set the date in July so the one-hour summer offset applies. In a winter version the UTC trick does nothing.
Gave Magnus a break at 00:55 to 01:05, after the vault closed, so players have to check break times against the real window.
Gave every source its own time zone note, so each conversion is fair and none relies on outside knowledge.
